rows.note: Use 卡通片 as the all-purpose noun for an animated cartoon film or TV cartoon.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 tai2 kaa1 tung1 pin2

rows.note: Use 漫畫 for a humorous comic drawing or comic strip rather than an animated film.

example.english: This cartoon made me laugh so hard.
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 maan6 waa2 siu3 sei2 ngo5 laa3

rows.note: Use 政治漫畫 specifically for a cartoon satirising politicians or other public figures.

example.english: The newspaper published a cartoon satirizing lawmakers today.
example.traditional: 報紙今日刊登咗一幅諷刺議員嘅政治漫畫。
example.jyutping: bou3 zi2 gam1 jat6 hon1 dang1 zo2 jat1 fuk1 fung3 ci3 ji5 jyun4 ge3 zing3 zi6 maan6 waa2
